scope: Fixed-before-new-results structural ablation on previously examined data/frontends/seeds. Development evidence, not independent confirmation.
information_boundary: No native actions or simulator queries during pretraining; cached observation-only predicted endpoints. Global freezing precedes budget-label access. Grounding unchanged.
factorial: 2x2: original MIF vs pooled non-Mobius control; endpoint+edge vs endpoint-pair coordinates. Common original endpoint+edge standardized reconstruction loss.
pooled_control: Original class reused as a separately named experimental control: identity Mobius/zeta, uniform all-to-all mixing on each of the same three axes. Same learnable tensors and dense operations. Not claimed to be original MIF or universal neural baseline.
edge_only: Zeros in endpoint input channels, differences retained. Full original reconstruction targets retained. Same allocated parameter count, but fewer active input weights: information-removal sensitivity, not equal-effective-capacity evidence.
partner_complement: Reference endpoint masks complemented within the SAME history/event/horizon/entity table. Query endpoint unchanged; no episode/timestamp reassignment. A fixed invertible permutation: tests alignment inductive bias, not irrecoverable information loss.
normalization: Fitted only on valid training observations. Pair input has its own coordinate normalization; decoded outputs converted to canonical endpoint+edge standardized units before loss. Complement inputs use original normalizer and reconstruct their own perturbed table.
resources: Original hidden sizes: MPE128/Ma108; z16; batch256/512; updates3200, history1200. Same optimizer, masked-cell RNG, seeds and schedules. Actual peak memory and timings reported; no claim of identical wall-clock time.
baselines: Formal Base, duplicate, LAPO/LAOM, BC/IDM comparisons read from unchanged original full-budget summaries with IDENTICAL evaluation seeds. Independent entity checkpoint reevaluated with new decoder; upstream training not resource-matched.
primary: Per training seed, equal-weight mean over ALL original budgets. MIF-edge vs pooled-edge and partner-complement in each of two environments: four two-sided paired t tests, global Holm. Remaining contrasts are descriptive secondary outcomes.
